visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with dark hair, wearing a navy-blue police uniform shirt and dark trousers, stands on a blue mat in a large, brightly lit indoor sports gym. He points his finger aggressively toward the camera while several other uniformed individuals sit on the mats behind him in a line. The background features mirrored walls and high ceilings with fluorescent lighting. (2) The scene shifts to a physical confrontation where two men in similar navy uniforms tackle the first man. They fall onto the blue cushioned floor in a chaotic struggle. One man uses his arms to grip the first man's neck and torso in a restraint hold, while the first man grits his teeth and tenses his facial muscles during the grapple. (3) A group of five people, including three women with distinct hairstyles and two men, stand in a horizontal line in the same gym setting. They are facing an older instructor who wears a light blue polo shirt and dark pants. The instructor gestures with his hands as he speaks, while the group maintains attentive facial expressions. (4) The instructor demonstrates a technique on a man lying flat on his stomach on the blue mat. The instructor uses his hands to manipulate the man's legs and feet, showing a specific control method. The group stands nearby, observing the physical demonstration closely with curious expressions. (5) The group and the instructor engage in a final discussion. One woman with short brown hair raises her hand and speaks while smiling. The instructor responds with a friendly nod and wide hand gestures. The lighting remains consistent and bright throughout the scene.
